name: Ro48-6791
summary: Ro48-6791 is a drug, an imidazobenzodiazepine derivative developed by Hoffman-LaRoche in the 1990s.

uses.text: Ro48-6791 is a drug, an imidazobenzodiazepine derivative developed by Hoffman-LaRoche in the 1990s. Ro48-6791 was developed as an alternative to the short-acting imidazobenzodiazepine midazolam, for use in induction of anaesthesia and conscious sedation for minor invasive procedures.

sideEffects.text: It is 4-6x more potent than midazolam, and slightly shorter acting, and produces similar side effects such as sedation and amnesia.

pharmacology.en: As a benzodiazepine, it boosts the effect of GABA at GABA-A receptors, the brain's main calming signal, which produces sedation.
pharmacology.zh: 作為苯二氮平類，它會增強 GABA 在 GABA-A 受體上的作用，也就是大腦主要的抑制訊號，因而產生鎮靜效果。
pharmacology.zhHans: 作为苯二氮平类，它会增强 GABA 在 GABA-A 受体上的作用，也就是大脑主要的抑制信号，因而产生镇静效果。

fact.en: Ro48-6791 was designed as a possible replacement for midazolam in sedation for procedures. Both are imidazobenzodiazepines, with an extra five-membered ring fused on.
fact.zh: Ro48-6791 是為了取代咪達唑侖用於檢查鎮靜而設計的。兩者都屬於咪唑苯二氮平，結構上多融合了一個五元環。
fact.zhHans: Ro48-6791 是为了取代咪达唑仑用于检查镇静而设计的。两者都属于咪唑苯二氮平，结构上多融合了一个五元环。
